data.one_liner: Create animated, simple, and stylish Material dialogs and bottom sheets in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use dialog classes (`Dialogs.materialDialog` and `Dialogs.bottomMaterialDialog`) that support Lottie animations, custom action buttons, and custom views.
use_when: You need standard Material confirmation or information dialogs with icons and buttons.
You want to display Lottie animations easily inside your dialogs.
You need bottom sheet material dialogs.
avoid_when: You are building a custom design system that does not use Material design guidelines.
You require complex multi-step dialog wizards.
strengths: Easy integration with Lottie animations out of the box.
Includes pre-styled button widgets like `IconsButton` and `IconsOutlineButton`.
Supports both standard dialogs and bottom sheet dialogs.
weaknesses: Limited to predefined Material dialog structures unless using custom views.
Lottie animation background colors may require external editing to match the dialog background.
data.minimal_example:
Dialogs.materialDialog(
  msg: 'Are you sure ? you can\'t undo this',
  title: "Delete",
  color: Colors.white,
  context: context,
  actions: [
    IconsOutlineButton(
      onPressed: () {},
      text: 'Cancel',
      iconData: Icons.cancel_outlined,
    ),
    IconsButton(
      onPressed: () {},
      text: 'Delete',
      iconData: Icons.delete,
      color: Colors.red,
    ),
  ]
);
